definitions: Preserves independent original finding IDs. A developer-authored test report is not equivalent to independent release-grade attestation; accepted final closure requires exact-source verification with authentic evidence.

findings.original_title: Approval-store predictable temporary file permits a symlink clobber in a writable store directory
findings.disposition: Private directory descriptor pinning (O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW), 0o700/0o600 permissions, atomic temp file creation via O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW with secrets.token_hex(16), fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX), fsync, and fail-closed corrupted file handling. Verified by test_independent_release_blockers.py and macOS negative test TEST-07.

findings.original_title: Process-group cleanup cannot enforce complete descendant containment
findings.disposition: Untrusted target execution disabled (RUNTIME_EXECUTION_ENABLED = False). IsolatedHostAdapter fails closed. The detached setsid() escape limitation was empirically demonstrated on macOS (TEST-06). Capability is strictly restricted to static-only analysis; dynamic execution requires an external microVM supervisor.

findings.original_title: Declared Git revision is not bound to executable source content at dispatch
findings.disposition: No untrusted subprocess dispatch is reachable; StaticHost strictly validates target and revision allowlists before reading source files via component-wise dir_fd traversal.

findings.original_title: Observation action does not require execution-spec authorization while adapter accepts command dispatch
findings.disposition: Subprocess dispatch explicitly rejects observe, staging, or remote requests (requires isolated-local with verify_local/modify_local). Subprocess dispatch fails closed while execution is disabled. Verified by TEST-02.

findings.original_title: Resource limits omit memory, disk, file-descriptor and process-count quotas
findings.disposition: macOS Seatbelt lacks cgroup-style memory/disk/PID quotas. Capability is restricted strictly to static-only analysis; dynamic untrusted execution is disabled.

findings.original_title: Mandatory 45 authenticated A/B/C trials absent from independently available evidence
findings.disposition: The five-case A/B/C protocol requires 45 unique host-authenticated case-arm-repetition trials. Three developer-reported multi-target pilot sessions are not individually validated and cannot be subtracted from the mandatory 45 slots. Accepted independent slots: 0/45. Numerical spending and human consent are pending.

findings.original_title: Condition C is identified by a mutable branch rather than an immutable evaluated Skill revision
findings.disposition: Condition C metrics now contain immutable SHA strings, but neither the historical pilot provider trace nor the bytes actually loaded in the agent session have been authenticated. A remediation commit or current source tree does not retroactively bind the pilot to that source.

findings.original_title: Runtime matrix is stale and contains a timestamp later than its own containing commit
findings.disposition: The stale timestamp matrix has been preserved; timezone confusion is the developer's plausible explanation, not an independent cryptographic reconstruction. A new macOS matrix reports 10/10 PASS for prior candidate cd83271a...; signed independent host provenance and final release source review remain pending.

findings.original_title: Benchmark target revisions and independent ground truth cannot be independently inspected
findings.disposition: Synthetic target repositories and ground-truth catalog exist in repository fixtures, but independent third-party human adjudication and source verification have not been performed.

findings.original_title: Legacy Markdown report can display scoped all-clear from unauthenticated synthetic PASS records
findings.disposition: render_report.py modified so unauthenticated PASS records cannot emit 'NO BLOCKERS FOUND IN TESTED SCOPE' (capped at CONDITIONAL LAUNCH). Verified by unit tests in test_render_report.py.

findings.original_title: Release metadata and protocol documents disagree with requested v0.5.0 baseline
findings.disposition: All release documentation, protocols, checklists, and manifest consistently identify the release candidate as prelaunch-security-audit v0.5.0-rc1.

findings.original_title: Telemetry sanitization protects command argv but logs unredacted destination and paths
findings.disposition: Destination URLs, query parameters, and raw paths are hashed with SHA-256 in host telemetry events. Verified in test_runtime_host_adapter.py.

findings.original_title: No independent macOS Seatbelt run or authentic target/evaluation evidence for this review
findings.disposition: Mac developer-host matrix reports 10/10 synthetic negative cases on cd83271a604ffeb5ed38cd403c7b82b289243fe1 (Skill tree 77585b64825659a5b2198c3701ea2e2aeeb1f53c). The code-bearing Skill tree is unchanged at reviewed parent c36ca6cf..., but host log provenance and evidence on the eventual release commit have not been independently signed or verified.

findings.original_title: Model supplied JSON cannot by itself forge HostAttestation in assess()
findings.disposition: Host callback and digest binding are strictly verified; threat requires a compromised or over-permissive host, not model JSON alone. Verified by TEST-08.

findings.original_title: Claim that all GitHub Actions checks were skipped or never executed is rejected
findings.disposition: GitHub Actions run 43760303379 at cd83271a604ffeb5ed38cd403c7b82b289243fe1 executed successfully: unit-and-contract passed (299 total / 267 passed / 32 skipped / 0 failed), mcp-stdio-integration passed. Only billable live-agent evaluation was skipped as designed.
